contexts.text: The fountains of the abyss, and the cataracts of heaven were stopped up () = that temptation ceased. AC 844.
The Philistines stopped up the wells () = that they were not willing to know interior truths... and thus obliterated them... To stop up = not to be willing to know, and thus to obliterate. AC 3420.
They have stopped up their ears...
Shut up the eyes, and stop up the ears, and then...
Like impure waters, stopped up and stagnant.
When the understanding has been blinded, the will has also been stopped up...
They want the understanding to be closed up, and the will stopped up... But it has been provided... that the understanding be not closed up, nor the will stopped up. Signified.
The understanding so stopped up that... Signified.
They stop up the caverns so closely that not a chink is open.
Which of them... does not stop up his ear as with cotton?
They have so stopped up their ears as with wax.
He hath... hardened their heart (). AE 706:9. AE 1081:2. AE 1160, Explained.
To stop up the ear lest he hear bloods () = not to hear falsities from evil.
The mouth of them that speak a lie shall be stopped (). Explained.
Their (conjugial) love would then be like the stopped up vein of a spring.
I a. With the eyes shut and the understanding stopped up.
